name: @blackie360/luma-events-mcp
description: MCP server and Codex/Cursor plugin for safely managing Luma events, guests, tickets, and hosts.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --minify-whitespace --platform=node --format=esm --target=node20 --sourcemap --outfile=dist/index.js && pnpm strip-generated-whitespace
scripts.strip-generated-whitespace: node --input-type=module -e "import fs from 'node:fs'; const path = 'dist/index.js'; const source = fs.readFileSync(path, 'utf8'); fs.writeFileSync(path, source.replace(/[\\t ]+$/gm, ''));"
